METIS ships several model families. This page gives a very high-level comparison
so you can pick a starting point; each model has its own page with detail.

| Model | Stochastic | Training cost | Inference cost | Sequence conditioning | Exact density |
|-------|:-----------:|:-------------:|:--------------:|:---------------------:|:----------------:|
| [MLP](mlp.qmd) | ❌ | Low | Low | ❌ | ❌ |
| [Transformer](transformer.qmd) |❌ | High| Medium| ✅ |❌ |
| [Flow Matching](flow-matching.qmd) |✅  | High| High| ✅ |❌ |
| [Normalising Flow](normalising-flow.qmd) | ✅| Medium| Medium|👷  | ✅|
